text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"...This game is difficult, isn't it? 
Well, considering the high quality of the 
prizes, it makes sense."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
No. It can't be helped. It came up so 
suddenly this time, after all.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Still, from the looks of it, it feels like 
I might be able to get it soon...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Next time, let us prepare 
thoroughly before taking on the challenge!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
